messages:
maria: Heads-up — new runtime metrics + dashboards PR merged to staging. Need alerting rules and pager mapping before we promote. TL;DR: KV cache hit/miss, request latency p99, SLO burn-rate, and GPU worker queue length.

chris: Can you paste the suggested alert exprs? Also we should avoid paging on transient p99 spikes during autoscale / bursty traffic.

maria: Added examples in the dashboard description. Draft suggested alerts below (rough):

```yaml
- alert: HighSLOBurnRate
  expr: slo_burn_rate{service=\"platform-api\",env=\"prod\"} > 2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    owner: platform-oncall
  annotations:
    summary: SLO burn rate > 2x over 5m

- alert: KVCacheMissIncrease
  expr: increase(kv_cache_miss_total[5m]) / increase(kv_cache_request_total[5m]) > 0.25
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    owner: platform-oncall

- alert: GPUQueueDepthHigh
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_queue_depth{pool=~\"renderer-.*\"}[3m]) > 80
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
    owner: infra-oncall
```

kevin: Prefer using a 15m burn window with 1h lookback per our SRE handbook. For prod: warning at 2x, page at 5x. Staging can stay more permissive.

anne: Quick question on routing: which PD schedules get critical pages? We have infra-oncall and platform-oncall. Proposed mapping:
- platform-oncall: model-serving regressions and API errors impacting customers
- infra-oncall: hardware, node/driver/kernel issues and pool-level capacity
We should make that explicit in the alert labels so PD can route. Also need runbook links in annotations.

chris: Agree. Also do we want to auto-snooze p99 alerts during canary/rollouts? Last rollout caused lots of noise because of traffic shifting.

maria: Plan suggestion: when a rollout starts, console will set annotation rollout=true on related metrics; alerts with label rollout=true should downgrade to warning for 30m, then escalate to page if persists. We'll add that to the alert rule via `labels: rollout: '{{rollout}}'` and conditional severity logic in our alertmanager templates.

kevin: Also add dedupe/grouping in PD: group by cluster_id + model_name to avoid storming. And set a 10m repeat suppression for identical alerts.

maria: Runbooks: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/alerts/kv-cache (stubbed) and https://wiki.internal/runbooks/alerts/slo-burn. I linked them in the annotation fields in the PR. Who will own the platform runbook? @anne?

anne: I can take platform runbooks and add escalation steps + commands to clear cache and warm it. I'll also add a checklist for validating metric cardinality before paging.

pagerduty-bot: Integration test succeeded. PD service 'Platform - Runtime' linked to eng-platform channel. Test incident created: INC-1234 :rotating_light: (will auto-resolve)

chris: Nice. Final asks before we promote: set burn-rate thresholds to warning=2x, page=5x; suppress alerts during maintenance windows; ensure alertmanager routes `severity: page` to PD key for Platform - Runtime and `owner: infra-oncall` to Infra PD key. Add `team` and `cluster_id` labels to enable grouping.

maria: I'll update the PR with those thresholds + PD routing keys and a small note about autoscale suppression. Pushing changes in ~15m.

kevin: If anyone can review when pushed ping me. Also add the metric `slo_burn_rate{team=\"platform\"}` to the dashboard so product metrics team can correlate.

maria: Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
